w: Performed the ground-breaking ceremony for a new Akshar Purushottam Swaminarayan Mandir.

In the evening assembly Swamishri emphasized the importance of the Sunday assembly, "By the wish and instruction of Yogiji Maharaj, the Sunday assembly is conducted at all Satsang centers in the world. Yogiji Maharaj used to say that one should forgo a profit of Rs.25,000 and attend the Sunday assembly. We have glory and importance for Rs.25,000 whereas the holy sadhu has glory and importance for God.

"One feels that he (Yogiji Maharaj) did not understand mundane matters because he had renounced the world and became a sadhu at a young age. But one will get mundane things in life. You will find someone who will bless you with money, even someone who will bless you with a child and worldly happiness but you will not find one who will give you God..."

While having dinner at 8.15 p.m. He had his annual balance sheet made for the financial year ending this March. From this he found he had a loss of Rs.11 lakh. Consequently, in a fit of anger he started beating up his partner. Then he beat up the watchman of his office complex. Eventually, the police restrained him but he had lost all sanity because of the shock, and then he died."

Swamishri, to a youth seated before him, said, "Be careful that you do not get a shock!" Youth: "That man did not have someone like you. Since we have you, there’s nothing to worry." Swamishri: "We should always nourish the thought that ‘Nothing is ours’. One who does not have the refuge of God comes to such an end. We have to understand that nothing is ours. We did not bring anything when we were born. That businessman did not live to spend the large amount of money he had and died for Rs.11 lakh. But if one has Satsang then one feels, ‘Let’s go to Swami and relieve ourselves’..."
In the evening assembly the small murti of Harikrishna Maharaj was honored.
In the evening assembly, after a discourse by Viveksagar Swami, a Bhangada dance was performed by Jasbir Singh and youths. Thereafter, a drama 'Pragat Ki Pahechan' was enacted by youths.

In his blessings Swamishri said, " God is weighed by devotion. He has created the infinite universes and all priceless things in this world. God has created pearls, placed gold in earth - all for the happiness of mankind. To please God one needs devotion from one's heart. He is not appeased by empty devotion..."

Swamishri visited the holy places for darshan. First he visited the Hanumanji mandir where Nilkanth Varni had stayed for three days, bathing each day by a nearby well. Bhagatji Maharaj cured many plague victims after they anointed the murti of Hanumanji with oil at his behest.

Swamishri also went for darshan at the Khimnath Mahadev and Laxminarayan mandirs. Swamishri explained that Bhagatji Maharaj used to dance in the mandir and spend his time here in devotion during his school hours. When people asked him why he did not attend school he replied that he had studied everything.

At 11.45 a.m. Swamishri arrived at the old Swaminarayan Mandir for darshan. On reaching the assembly hall, Swamishri pointed out that Shastriji Maharaj had explained the glory of Bhagatji Maharaj to Fulchand Sheth.
At 12.00 noon Swamishri came to the Swaminarayan hari mandir and explained that it was the birthplace of Bhagatji Maharaj and showed the pillar where Bhagatji Maharaj used to sit and discourse.

At 12.15 p.m. Swamishri went to the memorial shrine where Bhagatji Maharaj was cremated. After darshan, prostrations and arti Swamishri spoke about the glory of Bhagatji Maharaj. Finally he chanted the Swaminarayan dhun for the completion of the Akshardham project in New Delhi and other mandir projects.
At 5.20 pm Swamishri left Gadhada and arrived at Amdavad mandir at 8.00 pm. After darshan of Thakorji, Swamishri came to the 224th birthday celebration festival of Bhagwan Swaminarayan.

During Swamishri’s morning puja in Gadhada sadhus sang bhajans about the glory of Bhagwan Swaminarayan’s childhood. Thereafter Swamishri rocked Shri Harikrishna Maharaj on a decorated swing. Swamishri responded to the beats of bhajans being sung by raising his hands. Several sadhus danced around Swamishri and the air took on a festive flair.

Swamishri arrived in Bhadra at 11.45 am. In the evening Swamishri went on an observation tour of the ongoing construction of the new mandir complex. Thereafter Swamishri went to the river Und. With the river flowing on both banks Swamishri desired to bathe Shri Harikrishna Maharaj. The attendant sadhu bathed Harikrishna Maharaj in the cool river water while other sadhus chanted the ‘Shanti Path’. Swamishri sprinkled the holy water of river Und on his head and then onto the sadhus and devotees. Then Swamishri prayed for the completion of the Narmada Dam Project, the waters of the Narmada river to reach all parts of Gujarat, the supreme celebration of the centenary festival of BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha and the pratishtha celebrations of mandirs in Junagadh and Bhavnagar. Swamishri then told the sadhus to sing “Avya Hari Und ne tire85”, and responded to every verse.

During the meetings, a youth came for the darshan of Pramukh Swami Maharaj. After his marriage, because of his wife's stubbornness, things had come to the point of their living separately. Father and son were together. When the father calmly told everything, the son was weeping floods of tears before Swamishri.
Swamishri knew the reality, so he said, "There is no objection to your living separately, but keep serving your parents when they need you."
